answer: The ripple escrow is released only against a shale receipt, and the quill audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 59 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 139 aliases means carrying 206 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 3 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
